verdict.rationale: Supabase publishes its codebase in a public GitHub repository (supabase/supabase), describes itself as built with "enterprise-grade open source tools", and calls its AI toolkit "open source". Documented Docker Compose self-hosting and community references to it as an "open source" Firebase/Firestore alternative corroborate that the source is readable and runnable. missing for 10: explicit identification of the license (e.g. Apache-2.0/MIT) in the evidence, and confirmation that every service component (not just bundled third-party tools) is under an open license.
